candidates.name: RegisteredTask.LastRunTime
verified_facts: LastRunTime returns the time a registered task was last run
The value can be compared with current UTC and pickup request time
semantic_limits: Last run time alone does not prove success, duration, current liveness, or correct task identity

candidates.name: RegisteredTask.LastTaskResult
verified_facts: LastTaskResult returns the result from the last registered-task run
The result must be interpreted as a task return or HRESULT-style value
semantic_limits: A success-like result without receipt, process, and Git evidence cannot close the blocker

candidates.name: RegisteredTask.NumberOfMissedRuns
verified_facts: NumberOfMissedRuns returns how many scheduled runs were missed
The count provides evidence of scheduler delivery gaps
semantic_limits: A zero count does not prove the task ran successfully or produced the required outputs

candidates.name: RegisteredTask.XML
verified_facts: RegisteredTask XML returns XML-formatted registration information
XML readback can be hashed and compared with an expected read-only task definition
semantic_limits: Matching XML does not prove process liveness, single-owner execution, or successful receipt publication

candidates.name: TaskService.GetRunningTasks
verified_facts: GetRunningTasks returns a collection of currently running tasks
Visibility is limited to tasks at or below the caller security context
semantic_limits: An empty collection may reflect insufficient security context and must not be treated as global absence

candidates.name: IRunningTaskCollection
verified_facts: IRunningTaskCollection represents running task instances
Items can be enumerated and correlated by task path and instance data
semantic_limits: Collection membership still requires EnginePID and process-start correlation to establish ownership

candidates.name: RunningTask.EnginePID
verified_facts: EnginePID returns the process ID of the engine running a task
The returned value is read-only and can be converted to an integer for process correlation
semantic_limits: A PID can be reused; task path, process start time, command line, and current liveness must also match

candidates.name: .NET Stopwatch
verified_facts: Stopwatch measures elapsed time using a high-resolution performance counter when available
Elapsed measurement is separate from wall-clock timestamps
semantic_limits: Stopwatch values are process-local duration evidence and cannot establish absolute receipt freshness alone

candidates.name: .NET Stopwatch.GetTimestamp
verified_facts: GetTimestamp returns ticks from the timer mechanism
Timestamp differences can be converted using the Stopwatch frequency
semantic_limits: Raw timestamp values are not UTC and cannot be compared across boots without additional context

candidates.name: .NET TimeProvider.GetTimestamp
verified_facts: TimeProvider.GetTimestamp returns a high-frequency value for measuring short intervals
The system TimeProvider combines UTC time and Stopwatch-based timestamp services
semantic_limits: High-frequency timestamps still require UTC wall-clock fields for cross-host and Git receipt freshness

candidates.name: .NET DateTimeOffset.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds
verified_facts: ToUnixTimeMilliseconds returns milliseconds elapsed since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z
The instance is converted to UTC before the Unix time is returned
semantic_limits: Wall-clock timestamps can move due to clock correction and must be paired with monotonic duration and time-sync context

candidates.name: .NET RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes
verified_facts: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes fills a byte array or span with cryptographically strong random bytes
A random nonce can distinguish recovery invocations and receipt groups
semantic_limits: A nonce proves correlation only when preserved end-to-end; randomness does not prove authenticity by itself

candidates.name: .NET SHA256.HashData
verified_facts: SHA256.HashData computes a SHA-256 hash for bytes or streams
The resulting digest can be recorded for staging and post-move readback
semantic_limits: A hash match proves byte identity for compared inputs, not who produced them or whether semantic fields are truthful

candidates.name: .NET Convert.ToHexString
verified_facts: Convert.ToHexString encodes bytes as uppercase hexadecimal characters
Canonical hex output avoids separator and casing ambiguity in digest receipts
semantic_limits: Hex encoding is representation only and adds no integrity beyond the underlying digest

candidates.name: .NET CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals
verified_facts: FixedTimeEquals compares two byte sequences in time dependent on length rather than values
It can compare expected and observed digests without value-dependent early exit
semantic_limits: Equal digests do not prove receipt freshness, producer authorization, task identity, or successful Git push
